After the arrival of the [[Order of the Sith Lords]]' arrival on [[Kursid]], the [[Kursid Sith cult]] built some '''totemic figures''' that were only visible from the above to honor the Sith on the [[planet]]'s [[Kursid arid plateau|arid plateau]] by removing thousands of volcanic stones that covered the ground of the plateau.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kursid totemic figures were mentioned in the [[2012]] novel [[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />
